question.title: Downhill Neighbor Map
question.content:
You are given an m x n integer matrix heights describing a terrain. Two cells are neighbors when they share an edge.

Return a matrix of the same size where each cell holds how many of its neighbors are strictly lower than it.

 

Example 1:

Input: heights = [[1,2],[3,4]]
Output: [[0,1],[1,2]]
Explanation: The cell with height 4 has neighbors 2 and 3, and both are lower. The cell with height 1 has no lower neighbor.

Example 2:

Input: heights = [[5,5,5]]
Output: [[0,0,0]]
Explanation: Equal heights do not count.

Example 3:

Input: heights = [[2,9,4],[7,1,6]]
Output: [[0,3,0],[2,0,2]]

 

Constraints:

  • m == heights.length
  • n == heights[i].length
  • 1 <= m, n <= 200
  • 0 <= heights[i][j] <= 105
